newsitem.title: USA: Cascade to supply network to Williams unit.
newsitem.headline: Cascade to supply network to Williams unit.

text.p: Cascade Communications Corp on Monday said it will provide Williams Cos Inc's Wiltech Group with more than 25 network switches for its nationwide telecommunications network.
The company said the deal includes more than 25 of its CBX 500 Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) and B-STDX 9000 Frame Relay Multiservice Wide Area Network switches.
Frame Relay equipemnt is used to transmit data at high speeds. ATM technology handles high speed multimedia transmissions.

Wiltech will use the new network equipment to strengthen its infrastructure to offer video and multimedia services for broadcast news organizations, distance learning, advertisers, business television, video conferencing, and the Internet, Cascade said.
